pages.title: Sable Antelope
pages.text: The sable antelope ($(o)Hippotragus niger$()) is a large antelope of the wooded savannas of East and Southern Africa.$(br2)Mature bulls are glossy black with white bellies and face markings, while females and young are chestnut to dark brown. Both sexes have long, ringed horns that sweep back in a curve.$(br2)Sable live in herds of females and young, each watched over by a territorial bull.
